text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Scarlet! Happy birthday 
to you, Scarlet!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Thank you, both of you! Having 
people celebrate your birthday really is 
the best feeling♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... But are you sure you're fine with 
that? Your only present is a "happy 
birthday"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, absolutely no way! There 
are so many things I want, like magic 
books and plushies!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. After all, that's what matters 
most. Having someone look you in the eyes 
and say it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You know... My mom's always been crazy 
busy, but she'd always come home and 
celebrate my birthday with me no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There were times the presents didn't make 
it in time, though. Having my mom smile 
and say 'Happy Birthday' always made me 
way happier anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...I was happier getting to see Grandma 
than getting presents delivered home too, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, no way!! Anyone can just say 
"congratulations"! Let me celebrate it 
properly for you, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's about Mar-chan dolls or 
Sweep-san's magic... Scarlet doesn't just 
listen, she always helps out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So it shouldn't just be words. I want to 
throw a celebratory party for you. I'm 
sure it will be an unforgettable birthday.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Now that that's settled, let's go, 
you two! Let's eat up every single sweet 
treat at the cafeteria!
